CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid Community Applications templates maintained by crywolf203. This repository provides Unraid-friendly templates and documentation for AMA-Unraid, LRCGET, IPTVBoss, PyLrcGet and iMessage Archive. These templates are community-maintained wrappers around upstream applications or Docker images, with clear paths, ports, WebUI settings, and Unraid-specific setup notes. Template support is available through the repository Issues page; application support links are included in each guide.
